patthana8.17:1.1: dhammaṃ paṭicca na āsavo ceva na anāsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā na āsavañceva na anāsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na anāsavo ceva na no ca āsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. na āsavaṃ ceva na anāsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca no āsavo ceva na anāsavo ca na anāsavo ceva no ca āsavo ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā.
patthana8.17:2.1: na āsavaṃ ceva na no ca āsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na anāsavo ceva na no ca āsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. na anāsavaṃ ceva na no ca āsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na āsavo ceva na anāsavo ca dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. na anāsavaṃ ceva na no ca āsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na āsavo ceva na anāsavo ca na anāsavo ceva na no ca āsavo ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā.
patthana8.17:3.1: na āsavaṃ ceva na anāsavaṃ ca na anāsavaṃ ceva na no āsavaṃ ca dhammaṃ paṭicca na āsavo ceva na anāsavo ca dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. na āsavaṃ ceva na anāsavaṃ ca na anāsavaṃ ceva na no ca āsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na anāsavo ceva na no ca āsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. na āsavaṃ ceva na anāsavaṃ ca na anāsavaṃ ceva na no āsavaṃ ca dhammaṃ paṭicca na āsavo ceva na anāsavo ca na anāsavo ceva na no ca āsavo ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā.
patthana8.17:4.1: hetuyā nava, ārammaṇe nava, avigate nava, (sabbattha vitthāretabbaṃ.) na āsavaṃ ceva na āsavavippayuttaṃ ca
